value.author: Mohit
value.title: A wonderful and comfortable stay at Hilton Bomonti, with excellent service and hospitality.
value.text:
The hotel was excellent overall. The rooms were comfortable, the staff were professional and helpful, and everything was very well organized. We really enjoyed our stay and had a very pleasant experience.
— The only issue was with the tour booked through the Hilton Bomonti concierge. Unfortunately, the transportation was not well managed, and we had to wait for a long time during both the onward and return journeys. On the way back, the bus stopped near Sultanahmet and did not continue, so we eventually arranged our own taxi back to the hotel. Apart from this, everything at the hotel itself was excellent.

value.author: Derya
value.title: An exceptional stay with outstanding service and wonderful staff.”
value.text:
The room was very comfortable and exceptionally clean. We were especially happy with the staff, who were friendly, attentive, and professional throughout our stay. The breakfast was excellent, and every member of the breakfast team provided outstanding service. A special mention goes to the person in charge of the breakfast team — unfortunately, I don’t remember his name, but he was exceptionally helpful and professional. The whole team worked in a very organized and efficient way, and whatever we asked for was brought to us almost immediately. We were genuinely impressed with the service and left the hotel very happy and satisfied.
— Nothing negative to mention. Everything was great.
